environment.description: Flask application deployed on EC2 behind an AWS ALB with standard HTTPS listener (TLS termination at ALB, no client certificate requirements). ALB forwards all traffic matching path /api/* to target group. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. No WAF attached. Application runs as root in Docker container with host network mode.

config.alb_listener: HTTPS:443 with ACM server certificate only
